notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve sign-up. Primary product interest: Hosted API. Early discovery.

Key problem: intermittent high latency for end-users, mostly reported from UK/EU. Customer says: "some responses taking 1.2-2s for short chat turns; expected <300ms for our use case" - affects UX for live chat.

Context / environment:
- Signed up 2026-02-10, small trial traffic (~50 reqs/min peak).
- Defaulted to eu-west region during signup (thought it was closest to UK user base).
- Most paying users actually in NA (west coast) based on their product analytics.
- Using standard REST sync endpoints; client timeout set to 5s.
- Observed long tails on first token time and occasional >1s per-token times during bursts.

Customer asks / requirements:
- Guidance on region choice (should we point to us-west for most traffic?), recommended timeouts and retry policies, prompt length guidance and batching suggestions.
- Want simple, actionable checklist they can apply without infra changes - prefer Hosted API adjustments.

SE observations / quick wins suggested:
- Region: recommend routing primary traffic to us-west for NA majority; enable regional fallback to eu-west for EU users to reduce tail latency.
- Timeouts: client 10s overall but set smaller per-turn token timeouts (e.g., 2s for first-token timeout heuristics); use exponential backoff for retries to avoid requeue bursts.
- Prompt length: reduce system prompt size and avoid sending full conversation history; send last 3 turns + embeddings for context where needed. Encourage shorter max_tokens where possible.
- Streaming: switch to streaming responses to improve perceived latency for chat UI.
- Batching & caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts and consider request-level micro-batching for background reranks but not for interactive chat.
- Monitoring: use Redwood Console per-route latency breakdown (link sent in drive doc) and capture request ids for slow traces.

Customer feedback & quotes:
- "We didn't realize most of our users are on the west coast - happy to change region if it helps."
- Wants minimal code changes; prefers config toggles / SDK options.

Next steps (short):
- Schedule 45m tuning session with AE + SE to run live perf tests (us-west vs eu-west) and tweak client timeouts (ACTION: propose 2026-03-04 10:00 PT).
- Customer to provide traffic sample window & a few representative prompts (they already shared 6 examples).
- SE to prepare a one-page perf checklist and example client timeout/retry code snippets.

Open blockers:
- Need to confirm which region their production traffic will be routed from.
- Customer wants a simple SLA/timeout recommendation doc - creating one.
- Concern about handling EU users with low latency without adding complexity to routing.
